<b>Needle Phial</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Red|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It is used to extract [[Plasmium]] from [[Plasmium Bud]]s during the <i>[[Alchemist's Assistant]]</i> [[Wish]], and [[Plasmified Blood]] from [[plasmified]] enemies during the <i>[[Advanced Alchemy]]</i> Wish.

The Needle Phial becomes unobtainable after completing both Wishes. This tool is not required to unlock the <i>Arsenal</i> [[Achievements (Silksong)|Achievement]] and does not count towards the game's [[Completion (Silksong)|completion]] percentage.

== Usefulness ==
Though this tool can be used to attack enemies and destroy objects,  it is primarily used to complete the <i>[[Alchemist's Assistant]]</i> and <i>[[Advanced Alchemy]]</i> Wishes.

Successful extraction of Plasmified Blood on a non-boss enemy will result in an instant-kill for the enemy that the blood is extracted from. Using this Tool on [[Plasmified Zango]] inflicts 250 damage that Zango cannot regenerate and will persist even if Hornet leaves the arena or dies while fighting him.  

Because of the charge time required to successfully use the Needle Phial, care must be taken when using it on enemies as being damaged during the charge will cancel its use.

== How to Acquire ==
Given by [[Alchemist Zylotol]] upon starting the <i>[[Alchemist's Assistant]]</i> or <i>[[Advanced Alchemy]]</i> Wishes.

After completing each of the Wishes, Alchemist Zylotol takes back the Needle Phial.

== Trivia ==
* It is the only {{CrestSlot|Red|1}} that is not affected by the [[Pollip Pouch]] in any way.
* The Needle Phial can be used to harvest [[Skewered Organ|Skewered Organs]] for the <i>[[Broodfeast]]</i> Wish.
